input.objective: Find lodging before crossing the river.

cast.name: Mira
cast.role: The ferrywoman

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The common room of the Drowned Bell is loud with bargemen; someone is singing badly near the hearth.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I order a second ale and ask Mira when the tide turns.

window.speaker: Mira
window.text: "Before dawn. Drink slow, or you'll be useless at the oars."

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: By the time grey light came through the shutters the next morning, the common room was empty except for the cook sweeping up last night's broken glass.

input.objective: Forge the blade the duke ordered.

cast.name: Hald
cast.role: The old smith Max apprentices under

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Hald
window.text: "Again. Your hammer's drifting left. Watch the colour, not your hands."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I wipe my face and bring the hammer down, counting the strokes.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The billet rings and slowly flattens under the blows.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: A week later the forge was cold for the first time in days, and the finished blade lay wrapped in oiled cloth on the bench, waiting for the duke's rider.

input.objective: Set out for the mountain shrine.

cast.name: Sela
cast.role: A pilgrim travelling with Max

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The Corvin market is a crush of stalls, goats and shouting traders.

window.speaker: Sela
window.text: "Bread, rope, and nothing else. We can't carry your appetite up a mountain."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I pay for the rope and we push our way out through the north gate.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The road climbs steadily into pine woods. By noon the market's noise is long gone and the only sounds are their boots on the needles and a jay scolding overhead.

input.objective: Win the queen's ear at the spring feast.

cast.name: Lord Varric
cast.role: A rival lord

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Lord Varric
window.text: "Enjoy the wine, envoy. It may be the last you taste at court."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I raise my cup to him and smile.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text:
* * *

Down at the harbour, a hooded figure counts out silver into a fisherman's palm and points at the envoy's moored barge.

input.objective: Hold the tower until relief arrives.

cast.name: Orla
cast.role: The tower's other sentry

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Orla
window.text: "Another quiet night. I'm starting to think they forgot we're here."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Good. Forgotten soldiers live longer."

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Winter came early that year. When Max next climbed the tower stairs, frost had sealed the arrow slits shut and Orla's cough had not left her for a month.

input.objective: Reach the shrine before the snows.

cast.name: Sela
cast.role: A pilgrim travelling with Max

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The switchbacks grow steeper and the wind sharper with every turn.

window.speaker: Sela
window.text: "My feet stopped complaining an hour ago. I think they died."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I keep walking and offer her my arm.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: At dusk they stand before the monastery gates. Inside the walls, monks in grey robes are lighting lamps along a courtyard of worn flagstones.

input.objective: Find lodging before crossing the river.

cast.name: Mira
cast.role: The ferrywoman

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Rain drums on the roof of the Drowned Bell; the fire is down to embers.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "How did you end up running a ferry, anyway?"

window.speaker: Mira
window.text: "Twenty years ago I worked the big harbour at Saltmouth, loading spice ships from dawn to midnight. One winter the docks burned, and I walked upriver with nothing but an oar. Been here ever since." She turns her cup in her hands and watches the embers.

input.objective: Forge the blade the duke ordered.

cast.name: Hald
cast.role: The old smith Max apprentices under

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Hald
window.text: "Quench it now. Slowly. Let the oil take it."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I lower the blade into the trough and watch the smoke curl up.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The forge door bangs open and the sheriff strides in, shaking rain from his coat. "Hald. A word about the duke's sword," he says, eyeing the smoking trough.

input.objective: Find the index of land charters.

cast.name: Archivist Dorrel
cast.role: The archivist

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Archivist Dorrel
window.text: "Charters are kept with the deeds. Follow me, and touch nothing."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I follow him down the corridor, careful not to brush the glass cases.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Dorrel pushes open a door at the end of the hall and they step from the corridor into the next room, a long library of the same Archive, its shelves lit by the same high windows. He is already running a finger along a row of ledgers.

input.objective: Win the queen's ear at the spring feast.

cast.name: Queen Ysolde
cast.role: The queen

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Majesty, the river towns cannot pay what the crown asks. They will starve, or they will rebel."

window.speaker: Queen Ysolde
window.text: She sets down her goblet very carefully.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Nobody at the high table speaks for a long minute. The musicians falter and then play on, too brightly. At last the queen looks up from her plate.

input.objective: Hold the tower until relief arrives.

cast.name: Orla
cast.role: The tower's other sentry

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "You never talk about Brennick."

window.speaker: Orla
window.text: She is quiet a while, staring out over the parapet.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: She remembers the night Brennick burned: the bells, the smoke, her brother's hand slipping out of hers in the crowd at the gate. Then the wind gusts across the tower top and she pulls her cloak tighter, still at the parapet beside Max.

input.objective: Set out for the mountain shrine.

cast.name: Sela
cast.role: A pilgrim travelling with Max

cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: Describes places and everyone not in the cast

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Their room at the inn is small and smells of tallow.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I spread the map across the bed.

window.speaker: Sela
window.text: "Tomorrow we take the north gate, then the pine road to the pass, and if the weather holds we reach the shrine in four days." She taps the mountain with one finger and then yawns, still sitting on the edge of the bed.
